title: signing key bytes path skips file-permission check — intentional and correct
description: load_signing_key_from_bytes() explicitly documents that no file-permission check is performed. This is correct: permission checks are a filesystem-access concern, not a bytes-in-memory concern. A future contributor might add a permission check to the bytes path 'for consistency' — that would be wrong. The security model is: secrets manager is the trust boundary, not filesystem ACLs.
